name: owner_decisions
title: Owner-review AI questions that need game time (docs/spec-notes/owner-decision-captures.md): the detection Alert against IsInCombat (shots heard by hidden Fiends), whether spawned NCR troopers and Fiends fight unprovoked, and package durations (Hidden Valley's initiates and knights, whose packages 0x000D76E4-0x000D781C have durations and begin scripts; the two geckos at cell -17,-6 with their 2 h / 3 h chain). One game load serves all sessions in this order: god mode (tgm, a toggle) is in the first session only; the player is hidden for the first three and visible again from hv_initiates. All forms by FormID, so no --data is needed to write the jobs. Save caveat [observed 2026-10-18]: in nvfstrip Cook-Cook's camp is already dead, so alert_noise is not valid from it; the Hidden Valley and gecko sessions crashed from nvfstrip. Run this campaign from nvftest, its save.

sessions.name: alert_noise
sessions.note: Item 15. South of Cook-Cook's Fiend camp (the npc_battles spot), the player crouched, Sneak 100 and under a Stealth Boy, draws and fires three times: Fiends that hear it but do not see the player should go to the detection Alert (searching, weapon out, GetDetected 0). The sample fields in_combat, detects_player, procedure, weapon_out and alerted show what IsInCombat reads then. Needs the living Fiends of nvftest: in nvfstrip they are dead from the start [observed 2026-10-18].

sessions.name: clear_ground
sessions.note: Empties the loaded area (killall) for the next session; a short observation only.

sessions.name: ncr_fiends_placed
sessions.note: Item 14. Three NCR troopers (LvlNCRTrooper) and three Fiends (LvlFiendRandom) spawned together by PlaceAtMe, 1,500 and 1,900 units in front of the hidden player: do they fight with nobody provoking them?

sessions.name: hv_initiates
sessions.note: Item 7. Hidden Valley bunker L1: the three initiates (packages Matrix, Running, Exercise, Sandbox of 0x000D76E4-0x000D76E9) and the paladins, from 06:00 for 12 game hours: when each package starts and ends.

sessions.name: hv_knights
sessions.note: Item 7. Hidden Valley bunker L2: the knights (HVKnightWeaponRepair, HVKnightWeaponRepair2, HVKnightFloorRepair, HVKnightRepair, HVKnightSleep), from the next 06:00 for 12 game hours. Needs the console line `SetAlly 0001D3FE 0001B2A4` (BrotherhoodSteelFaction and PlayerFaction made allies): the ESM lists PlayerFaction as an enemy of the Brotherhood, AddToFaction VBrotherhoodOfSteelFaction did not help, and tdetect is not used because it also stops NPCs detecting each other (owner's ruling) [observed 2026-10-18, run from nvftest].

sessions.name: geckos_package_chain
sessions.note: Item 7. The owner's two geckos at cell -17,-6 (0x0016518B, 0x0016518C): from 17:00 for 14 game hours (find food 2 h, patrol 3 h, find food 2 h, patrol 3 h, then a sandbox that allows aggro, by our reading of their list). The 2026-10-18 run put the player on a gecko's spot (go: moveto) and they fought from 21:43; the rerun stands two cells away (cow WastelandNV -15 -6).
